value.rationale: The question is driven by Abella et al.’s stated need for finite-size stochastic analysis of aging contagion. The nontrivial full-graph positive bottleneck-depth invariant and coefficient distinguish serial and parallel social adoption and give a sharp topology-dependent logarithmic tail despite a universal moment threshold. This exact finite-network result is useful for estimating rare long cascades and understanding why mean completion can diverge under almost sure adoption; it is not a mere arbitrary numeric slice or discrete-simulation claim.
